dedupe_keys.name: sodma open data portal somalia disaster risk data portal

description: The Somalia Disaster Risk Data Portal is a CKAN catalogue for the Somalia Disaster Management Agency, jointly implemented by the World Food Programme and SODMA, steered by the project implementation unit of the Ministry of Finance (SCRP3) and financed by the World Bank. Its home page says it aims to help Somalia manage disaster risks through data, analytics and informed decisions and counts 1,013 datasets. The catalogue API shows that most come from ICPAC (576), the Humanitarian Data Exchange (223) and SWALIM (213), in formats such as GeoJSON, CSV, ZIP, shapefile, PNG, KML, geodatabase and GeoTIFF, with a group for public facilities. Searches return datasets on roads (55), health facilities (27), schools and education facilities (19), airports (8) and floods (176), such as flood prone areas merged from flood extents for 2013 to 2023, FloodScan and the paths of the 2018 tropical cyclone Sagar. Licences are set per dataset, mainly Creative Commons Attribution, Attribution Share-Alike and ODbL. Access is free with no registration for reading. Caveats: the portal runs on a development host (sodma-dev), many datasets are copies from HDX and ICPAC that cover other East African countries, and dataset quality varies. Coverage is Somalia and the wider region. It supports flood and drought exposure analysis for roads, health facilities and schools; related records are HDX and FloodScan.
